sections.Profile:
"Viper Night Drivin'" is a 1998 pinball machine by Sega, designed around a neon-lit street racing theme. It features two flippers, three ramps, and a four-ball multiball mode. The game includes unique lighting effects, such as glow-in-the-dark features and a soundtrack that adds to the nighttime driving atmosphere, with music contributions from Brian Schmidt and Slash.
